Message:
PQC Q5 (app): wire sk_pqc into skchat-app — DMs go hybrid post-quantum, incl. web

App-side of PQC-MIGRATION (e1d6ba2a, coord e248ac8f). The operator's actual DMs
now use hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 — including in the BROWSER (sk_pqc's noble
backend closes the WebCrypto-has-no-PQC gap). Web is the priority (the app is a
Flutter web build over tailscale); native liboqs-FFI is the mobile follow-up.

- PqDmCodec (lib/services/pq_dm_codec.dart): byte-for-byte mirror of
  skcomms/pqdm.py — encap (sk_pqc) -> HKDF-SHA256(info=_INFO_WRAP|aad) ->
  AES-256-GCM(body, aad=downgrade-lock) -> ct(1120)|nonce(12)|aesgcm, packed
  under the `pqdm1:x25519-mlkem768:` scheme. Same KEM vector as Q1 pqkem.
- PqPrekeyService: per-device hybrid keypair (sk_pqc.generateKeyPair) persisted
  in flutter_secure_storage + reused; publishes a PrekeyBundle to the daemon on
  startup; fetches/caches peer bundles.
- PqConversationService: seal on send (if peer advertises a prekey) / open on
  receive (`pqdm1:` token); records the per-conversation hybrid self-report.
  Classical peers unchanged; control sentinels never sealed.
- Send/receive wiring (skcomms_sync, conversation_provider) + main.dart bootstrap
  (generate + publish prekey on launch).
- UI: a PostQuantumBadge (shield + "PQ") in the conversation header when the
  conversation is hybrid-negotiated.
- Web noble bundling: web/pqc/{package.json,bootstrap.js} bundle
  @noble/post-quantum ml_kem768 to web/sk_pqc_noble.js (globalThis.skPqc), loaded
  by a <script type=module> in web/index.html before the Flutter bootstrap.
- Interop gate (test/services/pq_dm_codec_test.dart + test/pqc_vectors/): a
  Python-pqdm-sealed blob is opened by the Dart codec AND a Dart-sealed blob is
  opened by pqdm.py (verify_dart_vector.py) — both directions pass. AAD matches
  downgrade_lock_aad exactly; downgrade-lock fails an open on suite mismatch.

flutter analyze clean (new files); `flutter build web --release --pwa-strategy
=none --base-href /app/` green; dart codec test 6/6. Pre-existing Hive-init test
failures are unrelated (unchanged with these changes stashed).

deps: + sk_pqc (git: smilinTux/sk_pqc, local path override) + cryptography.
